khm.text: Istfell is the afterlife of the ignoble dead, and in Kaldheim it is where Ranar wakes as a spirit on an endless tundra, realizing the Valkyries have judged him to Istfell instead of Starnheim and resolving to prove his worth there.

He kills two demon guards who try to herd a river of marching spirits, and the freed spirits dissolve into mist, after which he reaches the gates and bridge of Istfell and waits there for centuries as guardian.

A living-looking youth calling himself Bjorn of Beskir appears and enlists him to climb a tower and cut a passage to Starnheim, and together they slay the Elk King and the Crow King, with Ranar's hands becoming whole as the kills restore life to him.

After the Bear King falls, Bjorn is revealed as Egon, god of the dead, and when he opens a rent into Starnheim the Valkyrie Firja seals it and tells him he must remain in Istfell, then commands Ranar to strike Egon down and names him guardian of Istfell.
